To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Household Indicators, which are designed to inform citizens and engage them in urban planning decisions, can be implemented as a web-based interface that presents simulation results using household-level indicators.

(1) the design and use of Household Indicators is a promising approach to communicating simulation results to citizens and (2) the design of Household Indicators can benefit from the design principles and methods of user-centered design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a system for presenting and interacting with simulation results in the form of indicators that are familiar and meaningful to citizens.
how to design simulation systems so they will be used by citizens.
how to design indicators to help people understand the complex, quantitative consequences of planning decisions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the household indicators are an innovative way of presenting urban simulation results to the general public in order to inform and engage the public.
the Household Indicators project is intended to provide a new tool to help citizens to understand the complex long-term consequences of decisions made by their local government.
the Household Indicators project is an ongoing design effort to develop a tool for citizens to use in understanding the consequences of urban planning and development decisions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Household Indicator is a tool that can be used to help citizens understand and engage in urban planning.
we have developed a new design approach to the use of indicators, one that can help to make the complex results of simulation understandable to citizens.
we have developed and implemented a set of design principles for Household Indicators, and we have applied them in a case study of the city of San Francisco.
The main takeaway from our work is that
indicators can be a valuable communication tool if designed to address citizen's concerns and needs.
the design of Household Indicator interfaces should be driven by an explicit model of how users think about their lives, which we call a household model.
indicators designed for citizens can be more effective than indicators designed for experts, and more effective than no indicators at all.
